intro: Dots is OpenAI's fast lane: quick tasks handled inside the chat, no heavy setup. That is genuinely useful, and it is also where it ends. The moment a task needs yesterday's context, your inbox, or your calendar, a lightweight surface has nothing to stand on. GAIA is built for exactly that work. It remembers how you operate, connects to the tools you live in, and follows through across days, not just turns.
